template.name: FVG Breakout Lite
template.notes: The exact 3-candle imbalance (low[t-2] above high[t-1]) cannot be isolated with windowed Donchians, so the pattern is approximated by a candle trading wholly above the prior two-bar range and closing beyond its high, with a fall back into that range as the gap-fill exit. The percentage stop-loss is mentioned without a value.
